title: MASkillBlender: Decentralized Whole-Body Coordination for Multi-Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Skill Blending
abstract: arXiv:2610.01102v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coordinated multi-humanoid loco-manipulation is promising yet challenging due to high-dimensional whole-body control, decentralized decision making, and scalability. While recent reinforcement learning methods have improved single-humanoid whole-body control, extending them to the multi-humanoid setting remains nontrivial and often requires substantial reward engineering or task-specific design. We propose MASkillBlender, a general multi-agent reinforcement learning framework to achieve decentralized multi-humanoid whole-body coordination. By learning a shared decentralized high-level policy over reusable pre-trained single-humanoid skills, MASkillBlender enables coordinated behaviors using only task-level rewards, without requiring task-specific motion references. translated_title: MASkillBlender：基于技能融合的多人形机器人移动操作分布式全身协调
translated_abstract: 协同的多人形机器人移动操作（loco-manipulation）前景广阔但充满挑战，其原因在于高维的全身控制、分布式决策以及可扩展性问题。尽管近期的强化学习方法已经改善了单个人形机器人的全身控制，但将其扩展到多人形机器人场景仍然并非易事，通常需要大量的奖励工程设计或任务特定的设计。我们提出MASkillBlender，这是一个通用的多智能体强化学习框架，用于实现分布式的多人形机器人全身协调。通过在可复用的预训练单人形机器人技能之上学习一个共享的分布式高层策略，MASkillBlender仅需任务级奖励即可实现协调行为，而无需任务特定的运动参考。为了提高学习效率，我们进一步为同构多人形机器人系统引入了一种基于置换的数据增强策略，并从理论上证明了该策略（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出了MASkillBlender这一通用多智能体强化学习框架，通过在可复用的预训练单人形技能之上学习共享的分布式高层策略，仅用任务级奖励即实现了无需任务特定运动参考的多人形机器人分布式全身协调移动操作，并引入基于置换的数据增强策略提升同构多人形系统的学习效率。
en_tdlr: MASkillBlender is a general multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that achieves decentralized whole-body coordination for multi-humanoid loco-manipulation by learning a shared decentralized high-level policy over reusable pre-trained single-humanoid skills using only task-level rewards, further enhanced by a permutation-based data augmentation strategy for homogeneous multi-humanoid systems.
